### F1
Experts: Record, with each decision, the condition that should reopen it, and watch for that condition.
Cue: A decision rests on an assumption that could change (load, cost, team size).
Case: Several teams that adopted architecture decision records found old entries went stale because no entry said when to revisit it.
Evidence: moderate
Source: S1

### F2
Experts: Tag each decision with its owner so questions have a named person to go to.
Cue: A decision is challenged and no one knows who made it.
Case: none
Evidence: weak
Source: S2
